moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Across UK
moments.blurb: Today, August 31st, marks the Summer Bank Holiday in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland, providing a long weekend for many before autumn officially begins.

angles.name: Relaxed Vibe
angles.copy: Happy Bank Holiday Monday! Whether you're making the most of the last long weekend of summer or just enjoying a chilled one, hope it's a good one. #BankHoliday

angles.name: Weather Check
angles.copy: That Bank Holiday feeling! Sunshine and showers predicted for many, but some warmer spells could sneak through. How are you spending your extra day off?

moments.title: Premier League Action This Weekend
moments.blurb: The Premier League season heats up this weekend with a full slate of fixtures, including Ipswich Town v Liverpool on Friday, and Everton v Man Utd, Arsenal v Chelsea on Sunday.

angles.name: Weekend Kick-off
angles.copy: Football fans, clear your calendars! The Premier League is back with a bang this weekend. Who are you backing for glory?

angles.name: Big Sunday Games
angles.copy: Sunday's looking HUGE for Premier League fans! Everton take on Man Utd and Arsenal face Chelsea. Which clash are you most hyped for?

moments.title: Manchester Derby Anticipation
moments.blurb: The first Manchester Derby of the 2026/27 Premier League season is set for Sunday, September 13th, as Manchester United host Manchester City.

angles.name: Derby Countdown
angles.copy: It's the fixture everyone's talking about! The Manchester Derby is just under two weeks away. Red or Blue, who's taking the bragging rights this time?

angles.name: Early Season Clash
angles.copy: An early season cracker! Man Utd vs Man City on September 13th. Will this set the tone for the title race?

moments.title: End of the Road Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The acclaimed End of the Road Festival returns to Dorset from September 3rd to 6th, featuring a diverse lineup of indie, folk, and alternative artists.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: End of the Road Festival is almost here! Who's heading to Dorset for a weekend of incredible music and good vibes?

angles.name: Indie & Folk Focus
angles.copy: Ready for some top-tier indie and folk? End of the Road Festival is bringing the best to Dorset this weekend. What acts are you most excited to catch?

moments.title: Lindisfarne Festival Returns
moments.blurb: Lindisfarne Festival takes over Northumberland from September 3rd to 5th, offering a mix of music, arts, and literature in a stunning coastal setting.

angles.name: North East Festival Fun
angles.copy: North East, get ready! Lindisfarne Festival is almost upon us, bringing brilliant music and arts to Northumberland this weekend. Who's joining the party?

angles.name: Coastal Vibes
angles.copy: Festival season isn't over yet! Lindisfarne Festival kicks off this Thursday, promising a fantastic blend of music and culture by the coast.

moments.title: British Country Music Festival in Blackpool
moments.blurb: The British Country Music Festival brings world-class international and UK country artists to Blackpool from September 4th to 6th across four stages.

angles.name: Country Music Weekend
angles.copy: Yee-haw! The British Country Music Festival is taking over Blackpool this weekend. Get ready for three days of incredible country and Americana.

angles.name: Blackpool Bound
angles.copy: Blackpool is about to get a whole lot country! The British Country Music Festival kicks off Friday. Who's got their boots ready?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Still #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean continue their incredible run, holding the #1 spot on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of Aug 27 - Sep 2 with 'Rein Me In' for a staggering 23rd week.

angles.name: Chart Domination
angles.copy: 23 weeks at #1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still reigning supreme on the Official Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. An absolute phenomenon!

angles.name: Longest Running #1
angles.copy: History in the making! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' refuses to budge from #1. What an incredible achievement!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Returns
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is set to return with its launch show airing on September 19th, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly Is Back
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing is waltzing back onto our screens on September 19th with a brand new hosting trio. Who are you excited to see?

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking over the Strictly ballroom! Tune in for the launch show on September 19th.

moments.title: The Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is scheduled to return to Channel 4 on Tuesday, September 29th, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge.

source.l: The Version / The Cake & Bake Show

angles.name: Bake Off Hype
angles.copy: On your marks, get set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off is back on September 29th. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent
angles.copy: A delicious new addition to the Bake Off tent! Nigella Lawson joins as a judge when the series returns on September 29th. We can't wait!

moments.title: Van Morrison Turns 81
moments.blurb: Legendary Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison celebrates his 81st birthday today, August 31st.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Van
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the iconic Van Morrison! What's your all-time favourite 'Van the Man' track?

angles.name: Musical Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible career of Van Morrison on his 81st birthday! A true legend whose music spans generations.

moments.title: Debbie Gibson Turns 56
moments.blurb: Pop icon Debbie Gibson, known for hits like 'Foolish Beat' and 'Lost In Your Eyes,' celebrates her 56th birthday today, August 31st.

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 56th Birthday to the one and only Debbie Gibson! Still shining bright since her 80s pop reign.

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: From teen sensation to enduring pop icon, Happy 56th Birthday to Debbie Gibson! What's your favourite track from her?

moments.title: Steve Jones of Sex Pistols Turns 71
moments.blurb: Steve Jones, influential guitarist and founding member of punk legends The Sex Pistols, celebrates his 71st birthday on September 3rd.

angles.name: Punk Legend
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to Sex Pistols' guitar legend, Steve Jones! A true icon of punk rock.

angles.name: Anarchy in the UK
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Steve Jones! The man who helped define a generation with The Sex Pistols.

moments.title: Gloria Gaynor Turns 77
moments.blurb: Disco queen Gloria Gaynor, famous for the empowering anthem 'I Will Survive,' celebrates her 77th birthday on September 7th.

angles.name: Disco Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the legendary Gloria Gaynor! Still surviving and thriving. What's your favourite disco classic from her?

angles.name: Empowering Anthem
angles.copy: 'I Will Survive' forever! Wishing a fantastic 77th Birthday to the iconic Gloria Gaynor.

moments.title: Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders Turns 75
moments.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday on September 7th.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon and frontwoman of The Pretenders.

angles.name: New Wave Legend
angles.copy: From 'Brass in Pocket' to 'Don't Get Me Wrong', celebrating Chrissie Hynde's 75th birthday! What's your favourite Pretenders track?

moments.title: Brief Warm Spell Forecast for UK South
moments.blurb: While autumn weather is generally returning, parts of Southern UK, particularly the South East, could see short-lived warm spells with temperatures reaching up to 25°C around Friday, September 4th.

angles.name: Late Summer Heat
angles.copy: Don't pack away the shorts just yet! A brief warm spell is forecast for parts of the South, with temperatures potentially hitting 25°C this Friday.

angles.name: Devon Sunshine
angles.copy: Good news, Devon! While the autumn chill is coming, we could see some lovely warm sunshine this Friday with temperatures up to 25°C. Time for one last ice cream?
